title: Bounce Cure
cardDescription: Email verification and marketing SaaS with bulk list processing, valid/invalid/risky detection, campaign workflows, analytics and API access.
overview: Bounce Cure is a web-based email verification and marketing platform that helps businesses improve email data quality. It supports single and bulk verification, campaign workflows with scheduled sending and follow-ups, and performance monitoring.
problem: Businesses sending campaigns to unverified lists get high bounce rates, damaged sender reputation and poor deliverability.
solution: A central platform to verify addresses (single or bulk), sort them into valid, invalid and risky, then run and monitor campaigns only on clean lists.
result: Teams clean their lists before sending, manage campaigns from one dashboard, and track opens and clicks to see what works.
features: Valid, invalid and risky email identification
Campaign workflows with scheduled sending and follow-ups
contributions: Built validation and campaign-processing API integrations
Implemented error handling for failed / invalid recipients
Worked on database operations and backend services

challenges.challenge: Processing large uploaded lists without blocking the UI.
challenges.solution: Bulk lists are processed in the background with progress and results shown on a dedicated results screen.

challenges.challenge: Failed and invalid recipients breaking campaigns.
challenges.solution: Added recipient-level error handling so bad addresses are flagged and skipped instead of failing the whole send.
